newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower after late break.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower after late break.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower and just above their intraday lows on fund-related selling that was ushered in by a late break in CBOT wheat prices, traders said.
"It was obvious that one company associated with fund trading came in and started selling everything they could get their hands on," a MGE trader said.

Before the late break in prices, U.S. wheat markets had been broadly higher on the day. Support had come mostly from CBOT soybeans, which posted a double-digit rally on perceptions of tight supplies, traders said.
MGE spring wheat settled 4-3/4 to 6-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with July down 4-3/4 cents at $3.83-1/2. New crop September lost 6-3/4 cents to close at $3.80-3/4.
